description: Arcane-caster-style burst mage - builds a Frost/Fire/Arcane Glyph chain off Elemental Burst and Primordial Blast, then detonates it with Glyphic Ruin or Thaumaturgy.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc (real playstyle/rotation/ability names) + confirmed screenshot numbers where available. Real mechanic per the sidekick Glyphic page: a sequential glyph chain - 'casting grants Frost Glyph, casting again while Frost Glyph is up grants Flame Glyph, casting again while that's up grants Arcane Glyph' - detonated via Glyphic Ruin (bigger cast-time hit) or Thaumaturgy (cheap instant). The chain is now live as three talent nodes (Frost Glyph / Flame Glyph / Arcane Glyph), each stage a real StatusEffect with its own unleash payload; the 'while the previous glyph is up' condition is carried by nested procs, which is the only conditional the engine exposes to talent data. The RUNES resource still meters the spender side (Glyphic Ruin and Thaumaturgy each cost 1), which is separate from which element is armed.

nodes.name: Wizardry
nodes.description: Increases Intellect by 3 per rank, and increases Mana gained per point of Intellect.

nodes.name: Cosmic Impact
nodes.description: Increases spell critical strike chance and spell haste by 1% per rank.

nodes.name: Well Educated
nodes.description: Increases maximum Mana by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Ley Magician

nodes.name: Expert Elementalist
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Elemental Burst and Glyphic Ruin by 6% per rank.

nodes.name: Glyph Seeker
nodes.description: Increases Primordial Blast and Thaumaturgy damage by 4% per rank.

nodes.name: Concentrated Magic
nodes.description: Increases Spirit by 2% per rank and reduces cast pushback taken.

nodes.name: Mana Runes
nodes.description: Increases maximum Mana and spell critical strike chance by 1% per rank.

nodes.name: Frigid Blast
nodes.description: Learn Frigid Blast, a delayed-release Frost nuke that accumulates damage before detonating.

nodes.name: Primordial Pulse
nodes.description: Learn Primordial Pulse, inscribing an area with runes that repeatedly damage enemies inside.

nodes.name: Glyphic Ruin
nodes.description: Learn Glyphic Ruin, unleashing your active Glyph's effect for a burst of Elemental damage.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: Lvl 20, 'Unleash your active Glyph effect on an enemy and deal 153 Elemental Damage.'

nodes.name: Thaumaturgy
nodes.description: Learn Thaumaturgy, a cheap instant Arcane blast that also unleashes your active Glyph.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: Lvl 36, '99 Arcane damage and unleash your active Glyph effect.'

nodes.name: Unleashed Power
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Glyphic Ruin and Thaumaturgy by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Eye of the Beholder
nodes.description: Increases spell critical strike chance and empowers Glyphic Ruin/Primordial Blast damage for a short window.

nodes.name: Manuscription
nodes.description: Learn Manuscription, a strong Arcane DoT that envelops the target and nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Glyphic Overload
nodes.description: Instantly grants all 3 Glyphs and empowers their next unleash. Usable while stealthed.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as the Glyphic burst capstone: 'Instantly grants all 3 Glyphs + overload: their next unleash gets a bonus effect.' The glyph grant is now real: casting Glyphic Overload arms Frost, Flame and Arcane Glyph at once, so the next Glyphic Ruin or Thaumaturgy unleashes all three without walking the chain. The 'empowered unleash' half has no engine hook and is not modelled; the Runes the ability itself generates stand in for the tempo it buys.

nodes.name: Devour Mana
nodes.description: Learn Devour Mana, destroying an enemy's mana and dealing Arcane damage based on the amount burned.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Destroys enemy mana; each point burned deals Arcane damage.'

nodes.name: Kirin Tor Adept
nodes.description: Increases the effectiveness of Eye of the Beholder by 8% per rank.

nodes.name: Runic Obliteration
nodes.description: Learn Runic Obliteration, a repeating Elemental-damage missile barrage where each missile grants a Glyph.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Repeating Elemental damage; each missile grants a Glyph.' Short-CD instant filler that both hits and feeds the glyph chain, per the playstyle writeup.

nodes.name: Silencing Rune
nodes.description: Learn Silencing Rune, a ground area that activates after a delay and silences enemies inside.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as a real school-lock/AoE-silence tool: 'Ground area, activates after a delay: silences enemies inside.'

nodes.name: Rune Master
nodes.description: Empower your casting, increasing haste and damage but raising costs, while draining mana. Cannot move while active.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Empowers casting (haste+damage up, cost up) while draining mana; can't move; scales with active-cast dealing damage.' A real channel-style burst cooldown.

nodes.name: Scroll of Magic
nodes.description: Unleashing Glyphic Ruin or Thaumaturgy has a 25% chance per rank to inscribe a Scroll of Magic, increasing your damage done by 4% for 4 turns. Stacks up to 3 times.

nodes.name: Primordial Salvos
nodes.description: Unleashing Glyphic Ruin or Thaumaturgy calls down a free Primordial Pulse on nearby enemies. Cannot occur more than once every 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Unleashing a Glyph deals extra same-school damage to nearby enemies.' Confirmed as the mechanism behind Arcane Unleash's AoE splash in the playstyle writeup.

nodes.name: Kirin Tor Agent
nodes.description: Casting Eye of the Beholder floods your runes with ley energy, increasing Haste by 25% for 2 turns and granting 2 Runes.

nodes.name: Unmaker
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your spells by 20% per rank.
nodes._source: Standardised 6 Nov: every caster tree carries one 5-point spell-crit-damage talent worth +100% at full rank, matching priest_shadow's Shadow Power and shaman_elemental's Elemental Fury (both WoW-accurate). Kyle: 'all caster classes should have a 5 point talent that increases their spell crit damage by 100%.'

nodes.name: Mind Wrath
nodes.description: Ley Lock's silence lasts 2 turns longer, its cooldown is reduced by 1 turn, and casting it grants 2 Runes.

nodes.name: Glyphs of Power
nodes.description: Your damaging casts have a 5% chance per rank to restore 200 Mana. Cannot occur more than once per turn.

nodes.name: Ley Walker
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of stuns on you by 30%. Taking damage has a 20% chance to phase you into the leylines, making you immune to crowd control for 2 turns.

nodes.name: Phase Rush
nodes.description: Casting Thaumaturgy throws you into a Phase Rush, increasing Haste by 20% for 2 turns. Cannot occur more than once every 2 turns.

nodes.name: Arcane Student
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Glyphic Ruin by 50%.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc, referenced in Glyphic's Strengths writeup: 'Arcane Student guaranteeing the Glyphic Ruin crit' when layered with Eye of the Beholder + Glyphic Overload for burst.

nodes.name: Cold Elements
nodes.description: Elemental Burst and Primordial Blast have a 10% chance per rank to hurl a free Frigid Blast at your target. Cannot occur more than once per turn.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc, Glyphic's Strengths/Weaknesses writeup: 'Cold Elements resets/instant-casts Frigid Blast' - keeps a hard Frost nuke available alongside the glyph chain.

nodes.name: Frost Glyph
nodes.description: Elemental Burst, Primordial Blast and Runic Obliteration etch a Frost Glyph onto you. Glyphic Ruin and Thaumaturgy unleash it, striking for Frost damage and chilling the target so it acts less often.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip: 'Using Elemental Burst and Primordial Blast now grants you Frost Glyph. Frost Glyph Unleash: Deals 437 Frost Damage and slows movement speed by -30% for 4 seconds.' Stage one of the chain the whole spec is named for, which Frontier had no trace of - the tree held every glyph CONSUMER (Glyphic Ruin, Thaumaturgy, Unleashed Power, Scroll of Magic, Primordial Salvos, Arcane Student, Glyphic Overload) and nothing that granted a glyph. Movement slows do not exist in a turn engine (see ranger_archery's own note), so the slow half is a Haste penalty on the target: turn_meter.py drives turn speed off Haste, so that genuinely makes the target act less often rather than being a flavour line. Runic Obliteration is in the trigger list because its own CoA line is 'each missile grants a Glyph'. Numbers are Frontier's.

nodes.name: Flame Glyph
nodes.description: With a Frost Glyph already on you, your next Elemental Burst, Primordial Blast or Runic Obliteration adds a Flame Glyph. Unleashing it burns the target on the spot and leaves the burn smouldering.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip: 'Using Elemental Burst or Primordial Blast while Frost Glyph is active now grants you a Flame Glyph. Flame Glyph Unleash: Deals Fire Damage and an additional Fire Damage over 6 seconds.' Stage two. A talent proc has no 'while effect X is active' gate - the engine's only conditional is a proc nested inside a buff, which is live only while that buff is - so this node hands out a chain-state buff alongside the glyph and the chain advances on the NEXT builder cast, which is what makes Flame land one cast after Frost instead of alongside it. Take this without Frost Glyph and you still only get Flame one cast in, so the sequence cannot be skipped.

nodes.name: Arcane Glyph
nodes.description: With a Flame Glyph already on you, another Elemental Burst, Primordial Blast or Runic Obliteration adds an Arcane Glyph. Unleashing it throws the blast outward onto everything crowded around your target.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip: 'Using Elemental Burst or Primordial Blast while Flame Glyph is active now grants you Arcane Glyph. Arcane Glyph Unleash: Deals Arcane Damage to up to N enemies near the primary target.' Stage three, and the reason the sidekick playstyle says you 'rarely want all three glyphs on a single target' - the Arcane unleash is a splash and is wasted on one enemy, which is also what Primordial Salvos in this tree is already built on. Two chain-state buffs deep rather than one, so Arcane cannot arrive before Flame. Splash is a share of the unleashing hit so it scales with Glyphic Ruin's rank instead of being a flat number.
